review.summary: You cleansed both Necrotic Poisons off Birkler on Maexxna, dispelled 9 Cripples on Noth and 3 Mutating Injections, and on Gluth you were out with the zombies (they hit you, your healing there is zero by design). Third healer on the Horsemen. On Kel'Thuzad you were chained at 2:00 and he made you cast Blessing of Sacrifice on him, so the raid's damage to the boss went to you until it killed you at 2:21.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Mageblood every pull, Distilled Wisdom on eleven, food on ten. No Zanza.

51114.text: Killed by your own Sacrifice, cast while mind-controlled.

review.verdict: Personal bests on Heigan and Thaddius, Curse of Recklessness all night, no deaths
review.summary: An 80 average against your usual 67, the top warlock on thirteen bosses, and no deaths where you usually have three. Heigan 98 and Thaddius 91 are personal bests and Patchwerk was 95. You kept Curse of Recklessness up all night and feared one of the mind-controlled raiders on Kel'Thuzad. Maexxna (16) was the one miss, and you spent part of it web-wrapped.

good.title: Kel'Thuzad
good.text: Feared Krits while he was mind-controlled.

fix.title: Maexxna
fix.text: 16, last in damage. You were web-wrapped at 0:58, which explains part of it.

review.verdict: Gluth's Frenzy handled, then a teleport on Heigan and an Icebolt on Sapphiron
review.summary: Your second Naxxramas in the logs. You put three Tranquilizing Shots on Gluth and parsed 82 to 87 on the first bosses, with Faerlina and Patchwerk better than your earlier kills. A Death Knight Captain pack killed you and five others on trash after Thaddius, and from the Horsemen on you had no world buffs, most likely lost there. Heigan teleported you away at 0:40, and on Sapphiron you were the Icebolt target already at 39% from Frost Aura, which killed you at 0:58.

good.title: Prepared
good.text: Titans, Mageblood and Mongoose every pull.

fix.title: Sapphiron
fix.text: The Icebolt itself is random. Being at 39% with little healing coming in made it lethal, so a healthstone or potion before the air phase is the only lever you have.

fix.title: World buffs
fix.text: All seven were gone by the Horsemen, most likely on the Death Knight Captain pack after Thaddius that killed six at once.

review.verdict: Most damage in the raid on Faerlina, then Maexxna took your buffs
review.summary: Faerlina 83 was the most damage in the raid and a personal best, and Anub'Rekhan 91 equals your best. Then Maexxna, right after her Frenzy, hit you once for 5,970 at 1:02, two seconds after you drank a Mighty Rage Potion, and all eight world buffs went with you for the twelve bosses after. Most likely threat. Mograine's fourth Mark killed you on the Horsemen at 1:52. On Kel'Thuzad your hits on Apoutchou came while you were mind-controlled.

good.title: Faerlina
good.text: 83, most damage in the raid, personal best (before: 73).

good.title: Anub'Rekhan
good.text: 91, equal to your best, second in raid damage.

good.title: Rage and explosives
good.text: 15 Mighty Rage Potions, 10 Sappers, 19 Dense Dynamite.

fix.title: Maexxna
fix.text: One-shot after her Frenzy, most likely on threat, and without world buffs for the rest of the night. Hold the rage potion until the tank is clearly ahead.

fix.title: Horsemen
fix.text: Still in range for Mograine's fourth Mark (4,005).

fix.title: Without buffs
fix.text: Last warrior on Patchwerk, Grobbulus and Thaddius.

review.verdict: Most damage in the raid on five bosses, and the top tank on the Horsemen
review.summary: You tanked the Horsemen (90, the top tank parse) and did the most damage in the raid on Anub'Rekhan, Patchwerk, Razuvious, Noth and Sapphiron. Thaddius 69 is a personal best. 11 Sappers, 9 Dense Dynamite, Juju Power and Firewater on every pull, no deaths. Gothik (28) was the only low one.

good.title: Most damage in the raid
good.text: Anub'Rekhan (95), Patchwerk, Razuvious (84), Noth and Sapphiron.

fix.title: Gothik
fix.text: 28, sixth warrior.

51107.text: 95, the most damage in the raid.

review.verdict: 72 dispels, the most in the raid, and a personal best on Kel'Thuzad
review.summary: A 60 average against your usual 44, with the decursing on top: 72 dispels, the most in the raid, including 15 Life Drains on Sapphiron and 4 Plaguebringer curses on Noth. Kel'Thuzad 90 is a personal best, and you polymorphed two of the mind-controlled raiders there. Heigan and Thaddius 86. No deaths against your usual 3.1.

good.title: Dispels
good.text: 72, the most in the raid: 15 Life Drains, 4 Curses of the Plaguebringer.

good.title: Kel'Thuzad
good.text: 90, personal best (before: 83), and polymorphs on Amima and Fluffycatto while they were chained.

fix.title: Gluth
fix.text: 17, last mage.

review.verdict: Curse of the Elements all night, then Life Tap and Doom on Loatheb
review.summary: Your second Naxxramas in the logs, a 60 average, and Curse of the Elements kept up all night (272 applications). Supreme Power, Mageblood, Greater Arcane and Shadow Power on nearly every pull. On Loatheb you Life Tapped to 40% at 1:44, the first Inevitable Doom tick took you to 24% at 2:11, and with healers limited to one heal a minute the second one killed you at 2:40, along with your five world buffs.

good.title: Prepared
good.text: Supreme Power and Mageblood every pull, 13 Mana Potions, 6 healthstones.

fix.title: Life Tap on Loatheb
fix.text: Healers get one heal a minute there. Tap only with a healthstone ready, or not below about 70%.

fix.title: Sapphiron
fix.text: 31, 25th of 26 in damage.

review.verdict: Top healer on Thaddius and Kel'Thuzad on your second raid, one Blizzard too many
review.summary: Only your second raid in the logs, and you did the most healing on Thaddius and Kel'Thuzad, second on Anub'Rekhan, Gluth and Noth, and shackled three Guardians on Kel'Thuzad. The one mistake was Sapphiron: the Blizzard caught you twice and killed you at 0:49. Hjärterkung brought you back with Rebirth.

good.title: Prepared
good.text: Distilled Wisdom, Mageblood and Fortitude every pull.

fix.title: Sapphiron Blizzard
fix.text: Two Chill applications at 0:38 and 0:45, and the second killed you at 0:49 (6,307). Move as soon as the first one lands.

review.verdict: All four Worshippers, Understudy control, top healer on Sapphiron
review.summary: You did the priest jobs and still healed: all four Worshippers on Faerlina, two of the Understudy mind controls on Razuvious, 8 Shackles and 9 Power Infusions. On Sapphiron you did the most healing in the raid (870 per second), and you were second on Maexxna and Kel'Thuzad. No deaths against your usual 2.2.

good.title: Faerlina
good.text: 4 Worshippers mind-controlled, the only one doing it.

good.title: Razuvious
good.text: 2 Understudy mind controls; the zero healing there is the job.

fix.title: Gothik
fix.text: 11th healer.
